body: The 02:30 heartbeat died on the same infra flake — that's three in about a day. Retries didn't save it this time, so I queued a replacement run manually. Nothing's lost; the retry picks up the window. If this keeps happening it's an infra problem, not something another retry policy will fix.

02:35 heartbeat completed on the retry — 464 chats to both repos, main → 1dec676, verified.

Two new datums: your NotebookLM tactical-autopsy inventory (flagged for a contradiction audit), and a 2018 Ally datum — a joke read as a threat back in December 2018. Also fixed a quoting bug in the push script while I was in there. Queue's at 25 pending, 19 done.
